title: Wren and the Vow
author: Bram Montrose
blurb: Silas Okonkwo, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
